scope: Capacity-constrained retrospective record-review simulation and hypothetical process-improvement scenarios; no model was used in contemporaneous clinical care.
action: Prioritize existing records for cardiovascular specialist review. This is an offline record-review exercise, not an admission-time alert or automatic treatment decision.
outcome: Capture of existing source-specific positive diagnosis labels. Positive labels do not establish untreated disease, actionability or preventable future MACE.
capacity_rule: Rank separately within each outer-test fold. Select an exact expected fraction of records using random selection in expectation within the boundary score tie. No label is used for ranking or tie resolution.
threshold_rule: Select if score >= numerical cutoff; the grid was not selected for performance and is not clinically endorsed.
comparability: primary_raw and age use identical outer-training populations. base_platt is the independently calibrated version of base_raw, which uses a smaller fitting population; it is not calibrated primary_raw. China is patient-weighted; MIMIC is admission-weighted with patient-cluster uncertainty. No pooled clinical task is constructed.

bootstrap.unit: patient; retain all admissions of each sampled MIMIC patient
bootstrap.capacity_in_each_resample: Recompute the score quantile using resampled weights within each original test fold, retaining the fixed capacity fraction.
bootstrap.assumption_uncertainty: Effect parameters are fixed within each scenario; grid variation is not a confidence interval. No Monte Carlo process noise is added to exact expected values.

parameter_meanings.a: Fraction of selected positive-labelled records with an unresolved issue under usual care that could be addressed by the additional specialist review.
parameter_meanings.u: Probability that the recommendation following a completed review is implemented; all selected records are assumed reviewed.
parameter_meanings.b: Conditional probability that implementation achieves a process improvement, such as completing a specialist-confirmed outstanding assessment. Not probability of preventing MACE.
parameter_meanings.h: Probability per completed review of an adverse process consequence, such as an erroneous escalation of testing. Not an estimated serious-harm rate.

scenario_formula.net_effect: Benefits and adverse consequences are reported separately. They are not subtracted without an elicited utility weight.

illustrative_example.designation: Arithmetic illustration only, not a best estimate or recommended scenario.

assumption_sensitivity: Also report the ratio of model-selected to comparator-selected actionability needed to preserve a hypothetical benefit advantage, assuming equal uptake and success. This is not measured actionability.
source_output_policy: Only aggregate results, paths and environment versions; no patient identifiers or row-level clinical data in outputs. Original models, results and v22 submission files remain unchanged.

method_sources.use: Separate numerical cutoffs from clinically justified action thresholds.
